_afk_note: Each turn a player lets TIME OUT shaves afk_penalty_step off their turn timer, cumulative and floored at afk_min_timer; finishing a turn MANUALLY resets it. Missing afk_forfeit_misses turns IN A ROW auto-forfeits. The effective timer is maxf(afk_min_timer, default_match_timer - afk_penalty_step * misses) (components/match.gd:713).
_draft_note: draft_pick_quota is the alternating pick pattern (1,2,2,1). The whole ranked DRAFT path is currently DEAD CODE — start_ranked_draft() has zero callers — so these constants describe an unreachable feature. Kept as spec, not as a port requirement; see the roadmap's decision on whether to implement drafting.
